piezime: Shared plan with Daugavpils: the Augšdaugava folder only has pointer stubs, so records cite ../daugavpils/cap_aktualizets_2026_05_gala_novads.md, table 5.2 'Evakuācijas pulcēšanās vietas Augšdaugavas novadā' (p. 136–138, 40 rows, Lat/Lon mostly comma decimals; rows are spread over several lines). Temporary accommodation is in annex 4, marked restricted (ierobežotas pieejamības). Daugavpils city's own table 5.1 is not included here.
